name: motion-sidechain-duck
title: Sidechain Duck
description: Mỗi tiếng trống kick, chuyển động nền khựng lại một chút rồi hồi về chậm như sidechain trong nhạc.

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio sd-duck, written here): On each kick the ambient motion (camera, background) dips: attack ~3 frames (100 ms), release 24-36 frames (800-1200 ms). Demo: every 0.5 s the duck rises linearly over 25 ms then decays e^(-12 t); background scale 1 - 0.08 x duck while the foreground dot grows 20 -> 30 px. Params: amount (−8 %) · attack (0.1 s) · release (0.8–1.2 s). Like a sidechain compressor: on each kick the ambient motion dips fast and recovers slowly.
